production.note: US model years. INFINITI USA: the Q60 'was sold in the U.S. from 2014–2022 (second generation from 2017–2022)' and 'The INFINITI Q60 was discontinued in 2022.' The 2017 Red Sport 400 was priced in INFINITI's 9 September 2016 release (infiniti-us-2017-q60-rs400-pricing); Motor1 quotes INFINITI: 'The Infiniti Q60 sport coupe will not be available in the Americas after the 2022 model year' (motor1-q60-ending).

body.note: Two-door sports coupe. The previous-generation Q60 Convertible was not continued in this generation.

aspiration.note: 'Twin turbochargers' with 'twin water-to-air charge coolers with two water pumps'

fuel.note: Gasoline twin-turbo V6; no hybrid version.

drivetrain.note: Offered as Rear-Wheel Drive (RWD) or INFINITI Intelligent All-Wheel Drive (AWD) at a $2,000 higher MSRP ($51,300 RWD, $53,300 AWD for 2017). The record describes the RWD car.

transmission.note: '7-speed automatic w/Sport mode and Downshift Rev Matching'. No manual offered.

powerHp.note: Quote: "400 hp @ 6,400 rpm" (RED SPORT 400 column). The same rating applies for every year: 2017 release '400 horsepower and 350 lb-ft of torque from new VR-series 3.0-liter V6 twin-turbo engine' (infiniti-us-2017-q60-rs400-pricing) and 2022 press kit '400 hp @ 6,400 rpm' (infiniti-us-2022-q60-press-kit).

weightLb.note: RED SPORT 400 RWD, 7-speed automatic, 2020 model. Quote: "Front 2,215 Rear 1,667 Total 3,882" (CURB WEIGHTS (lbs), Q60 RED SPORT 400 RWD column; AWD is 4,047 lb). The 2021 press kit gives the same 3,882 lb (infiniti-us-2021-q60-press-kit); the 2022 press kit gives "2,233 1,674 3,907" for the RWD car (infiniti-us-2022-q60-press-kit). The 2018 and 2019 press kits print no curb weights. The 2017 press kit (infiniti-us-2017-q60-press-kit) prints only a metric 'Weights (kg)' table (3.0t 400 RWD 1,752 kg, AWD 1,825 kg) with power also in PS and kW and no market stated, so it was not treated as a US pound figure; the reference year is therefore 2020, the first year with a US curb weight in pounds.

discrepancies.reason: Model year. Both are INFINITI USA curb weights for the Red Sport 400 RWD: 3,882 lb in the 2020 and 2021 press kits, 3,907 lb in the 2022 press kit.
discrepancies.resolution: Used 3,882 lb because the reference model year is 2020.
